name: Fairfield Public Library - Mahjong (Main & Woods branches)
description: Weekly library mahjong group at the Main and Woods branches. Registration required; no walk-ins; register for one location per week. The page does not mention American Mahjong or NMJL, so the style is unconfirmed.
